analysis_options.ghidra_symbols: ELF/BFD symbols only; no Java DWARF analyzer
analysis_options.rugra_symbols: ELF symbols only; no DWARF importer
analysis_options.rugra_build_profile: release; debug currently exposes VARMAP-GATHEROFFSET-0001 and RULE-COLLECTTERMS-0001 overflow defects

raw_code_policy.rugra: FlowInfo reachable instructions from the function entry, using one configured SleighCtx and the atomic Sleigh::oneInstruction step plus emitted ops

observation.schema: ordered JSON object graph with stable per-run PcodeOp/Varnode IDs
observation.normalization: JSON object keys/whitespace plus LOAD/STORE input0 AddrSpace pointer to registered space index; array order, object identity, aliasing, edge slots, flags, state and text are preserved
observation.heritage_boundary_note: Ghidra stops the real decompile Action at paramdouble immediately after heritage; Rugra replays ActionHeritage directly because its Action tree has no stage observer, so this layer is diagnostic and cannot be promoted to MATCH.
observation.rugra_determinism_note: Two independent release-profile Rugra executions produce byte-identical ordered JSON at all six layers; the runner still retains the second run and rejects any future difference.

first_op_storage_difference.diagnosis: Both sides resolve the first direct CALL to 0x22f0, but locked Ghidra encodes FuncCallSpecs in dynamic fspace index 5 while Rugra's fixed AddressSpace enum has no Fspec variant and uses synthetic Iop index 7 (ADDR-0001/CALLSPEC-0001).

closed_varnode_state_difference.diagnosis: Funcdata::set_arch now injects the Architecture-owned standalone TypeFactory into VarnodeBank before allocation. All ordered raw Varnode flags and complete type records match; storage, create index and traversal order are unchanged.

char_zero_read_facing.identity_contract: The pointer guard slot 0 and LOAD slot 1 are the same Varnode identity; the character compare slot 0 is defined directly by that LOAD, slot 1 is the size-1 zero constant, and the compare output is consumed in branch slot 1. No op id, time, order, or opcode spelling is normalized.

short_circuit_character_token.normalization: Only the producer-local spelling proven by the 03_action_ir register:48:8 def-use chain is projected to the value_pointer role. Both original lines remain in comparison.json; no global identifier replacement, regex text rewrite, whitespace removal, cast removal, or literal normalization is permitted.
